implementation_review: SessionOptions owns a thread-safe SliceDatasetSetting. Active and staged datasets remain immutable and distinct. Complete latest analysis alone requests a monotonic epoch; unchanged current desired fingerprint/config is a no-op. A->B->A still supersedes correctly.

Session worker alone activates. Image-consuming Excel resets/reopens its pristine private copy, clears old recommendations and consumes current observation as baseline. It resumes only on a different fresh key/layer that is actually eligible to calculate, including available control and finite required actual settings. Every ineligible valid waiting observation updates the consumed baseline, blocking cached or same-layer corrections.

Admission checked before each heater apply. A previously admitted Save may finish/verify under the old epoch; another old write is blocked and activation is acknowledged only afterward. Image change/cancellation never reuses session shutdown to interrupt Save. Existing ambiguity/fault handling is retained.

Builtin control and Excel without image mapping retain their original calculation history; monitor is annotation-only. Stale image annotations are suppressed in every mode, while valid image-independent math and raw/applied history remain.

Main GUI leaves image controls available while keeping workbook/algorithm/cell selectors locked. Analysis and connection generations reject stale publication. Active/pending badges reconcile from authoritative binding each GUI pump so bounded event loss cannot leave a false profile label.

Analyzer hashes complete bytes after size checks, retains at most256 successful numeric tuples per analysis, still reads every ZIP member/CRC and updates every layer/name/hash/powder-run record. Grayscale L identity avoids a copy; alpha/palette/inversion/ROI masks/arithmetic/order are unchanged. No NumPy or parallel decoding added.
